primary_mechanistic_inference_from_froze.design_consequence: v0.31 must redesign calibration and decision translation from reliability evidence to intervention while preserving stable-reference and bounded-action principles.
primary_mechanistic_inference_from_froze.finding: The dominant limitation is the evidence-to-intervention mapping rather than failure of the stable reference itself.
